=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- CI observation (out of PR scope, blocking the merge, not actionable by this PR): The current head SHA `ee1ce04` has the `lint` and `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` jobs red. The `lint` failure is downstream of the test failure: it reports `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator: failure` from CI_NEEDS_JSON. The failing test is `tests/test_claude_anthropic_relay.py::test_broker_rejects_client_authorization`, which raises `BrokenPipeError: [Errno 32] Broken pipe` inside `connection.request("POST", "/v1/messages", body, ...)` at line 182. The cross-pollination consensus (Gemini-3.8-flash + gpt-6-luna) attributes the failure to the relay closing the socket before the client finishes sending the request body after seeing the `Authorization` header. Neither `tests/test_claude_anthropic_relay.py` nor `scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py` appears in the PR's changed files (it is not in `pr_changed_files`, the symbol diff summary, or any of the LAST RUN DIFF hunks), so this PR neither introduced nor interacts with the failure. The fix is in the test (wrap the request/response in `try/except BrokenPipeError`, or use a different transport), not in the dispatch-head / safe-path / symlink-guard work in this PR. The PR's own work passes: the dispatched PR-head regression tests, the safe-path contract, the static-context symlink guards, and the OpenCode rejection guard are all in the diff and the corresponding test modules are wired into `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Operator decision needed: fix the test in a follow-up (or accept the regression) before this PR can move past `lint`.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:lines 102-104, `_reject` method | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `_reject` method calls `self.send_error(status)` which writes the HTTP error response and then sets `self.close_connection = True`, but it does not drain the request body first. When the broker rejects a request that carries a body (e.g. the `Authorization` is not None), the server writes the 400 response and closes the socket before the client has finished sending its POST body. The client's `http.client.HTTPConnection.request()` then raises `BrokenPipeError` on `sock.sendall(body)` because the server end of the socket is already closed.
  WHY: The CI job `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` fails on `test_broker_rejects_client_authorization` with `BrokenPipeError: [Errno 32] Broken pipe` at `connection.request("POST", "/v1/messages", body, ...)` (test_claude_anthropic_relay.py:182). The test cannot reach `connection.getresponse()` to assert the 400 status. This is a real CI failure on the PR head (run 37303611016, job 111741924051). The fix is for `_reject` to drain the request body (via `self.rfile.read(int(length))` when Content-Length is a valid integer) before calling `send_error`, so the client can finish sending before the server writes the rejection and closes.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
